  • Free online course in R [2 Updates]
 Free online course in R
    Anna Steel <annae...@gmail.com> Oct 07 09:19PM -0700  

    Hello all,
     
    I'm thrilled this group has come together...it seems much more practical
    than pawing through pages and pages of frustrating forums hoping for
    insight!
     
    This email is intended to start a conversation to find out how much
    interest there is in a workshop series or course focused on providing
    hands-on experience for R-beginners. It would be basic, mainly focusing on
    data management/manipulation - I'm envisioning that it would give new users
    the basic skills to navigate around a large data-set (clean, sort, etc),
    run basic functions (create random number series, run linear models,
    anovas, etc) and create useful graphics. It would provide the basic
    knowledge necessary to read help menus and other resources in order to
    learn new (more specialized) analysis techniques.
     
    I'm curious to know a) if there is interest, and if so, b) if folks would
    prefer a series of workshops or a course for credit.
     
    Thanks for the feedback!
    Anna
